'''NK Kustošija''' is a Croatian professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Zagreb]], which currently competes in the [[First Football League (Croatia)|Prva NL]], the second level of [[Croatian football league system]]. Kustošija{{'}}s home ground is the [[Kustošija Stadium]] in [[Zagreb]], which has a capacity of 2,550 spectators. It was founded in 1929.

Kustošija also have a football school attached to the club, where a number of children of famous Croatians have trained due to its location in the center of Zagreb.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.jutarnji.hr/vijesti/%E2%80%98nk-kustosija-nije-dinamo-ni-hajduk-ali-za-nas-igraju-todoric-ivanisevic-simici-sokota...%E2%80%99/924122/|title=NK Kustošija nije Dinamo ni Hajduk, ali za nas igraju Todorić, Ivanišević, Šimići, Šokota...|last=Žukina|first=Predrag|publisher=jutarnji.hr|date=1 December 2013|access-date=1 August 2018|archive-date=2 August 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180802011505/https://www.jutarnji.hr/vijesti/%E2%80%98nk-kustosija-nije-dinamo-ni-hajduk-ali-za-nas-igraju-todoric-ivanisevic-simici-sokota...%E2%80%99/924122/|url-status=live}}</ref>"}}
